item.title: Brazilian Amazon deforestation falls to lowest on record as pivotal vote looms
item.description: Forest clearance at smallest total since records began in 1988 in success for Lula ahead of presidential run-off Deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon has fallen to its lowest level since records began, new government data shows. But whether this globally important success is maintained or reversed is on a knife edge ahead of a presidential election run-off on 25 October between two candidates with sharply different visions for the future of the rainforest and how that affects relations with the US under Donald Trump. item.title: Lula recurre a un paquete billonario de medidas populistas y activa la calle para frenar a Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A escasos nueve días de la decisiva segunda vuelta presidencial del próximo 25 de octubre, Brasil asiste a una corrida frenética en la que Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva y Flávio Bolsonaro pugnan por inclinar a su favor un empate técnico en las encuestas que tiene al país en vilo. Tras quedar a menos de dos millones de votos del candidato de la derecha radical en la primera ronda, el veterano mandatario izquierdista ha rediseñado su estrategia apelando a los recursos del Estado. Lula ha abandonado el discurso macroeconómico por otro populista, desplegando un billonario «paquete de bondades»… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.description: Donald Trump nombró a Katie Zacharia jefa de prensa de la Casa Blanca la semana pasada. Una rueda de prensa, un puñado de entrevistas y una polémica sobre sus credenciales académicas han bastado para dejarla fuera en solo cinco días. El propio presidente lo ha reconocido este viernes ante los periodistas que le esperábamos antes de que se subiera al helicóptero Marine One, poco antes de viajar a un mitin en Georgia. «Le he preguntado si este trabajo es para ella», ha explicado Trump. «Le he dicho que, sinceramente, si yo fuera ella, me lo replantearía. item.title: Mansour Abbas, el candiato árabe en Israel que busca "una alianza con los judíos": 'NYT'
item.description: Israel irá a las urnas el próximo 27 de octubre para elegir los 120 miembros de la Knéset, el Parlamento del país. Dichos comicios determinarán qué partidos pueden formar una coalición parlamentanria y quién podrá gobernan. En ese contexto, sobresale un particular perfil: Mansour Abbas. Se trata de un influyente político árabe que, de acuerdo a 'The New York Times', busca alianzas con "los judíos" israelíes. ¿Quién es Abbas y por qué su figura cobra tanta importancia en estas elecciones? item.title: Caso Maduro: ¿Qué sigue en el proceso tras declararse no culpable de conspiración para tortura?
item.description: El depuesto presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro y su esposa, Cilia Flores, se enfrentan a un nuevo frente judicial en Estados Unidos, tras declararse no culpable de los cargos relacionados con una presunta conspiración para torturar a opositores. Maduro calificó las acusaciones de la Fiscalía estadounidense de "falsas", mientras que Flores afirmó que es "completamente inocente". ¿Es un caso independiente o una ampliación del proceso por narcoterrorismo? ¿Qué sigue en los tribunales? Lo conversamos en el #InvitadoDelDíaF24 con Román Ibarra, abogado y profesor de derecho y ciencia política. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Argentine demonstration over education cuts ends in clashes
item.description: Argentine demonstrators clashed with police on Thursday at a major protest in Buenos Aires over budget-slashing President Javier Milei's higher education spending. The main demonstration outside parliament by thousands of university students and staff, trade unionists and opposition activists remained peaceful. But dozens of mostly hooded demonstrators who broke away from the crowd lobbed stones and other projectiles at the police, who responded with tear gas and water cannons. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.description: El presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin , ha llamado este viernes por la tarde al Papa León XIV , que permanece ingresado en el Hospital Gemelli tras la operación para extirparle un tumor maligno del pulmón. El Pontífice ha pedido al líder de Moscú « un alto el fuego para permitir la llegada de ayuda humanitaria» y se ha referido en particular a la «gravísima situación» de la ciudad de Oleshki, según ha informado el Vaticano.El Vicario de Cristo ha pedido al presidente ruso un alto el fuego para permitir « el suministro de alimentos y asistencia médica , así como la evacuación voluntaria y segura… Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.

item.title: Cost-of-living demonstrations to grip pre-election France
item.description: After weeks of student protests, France is set to be swept by broader, nationwide demonstrations Saturday over the cost of living, setting up a potentially fraught period ahead of presidential elections next year. The prospect of the two movements merging, perhaps with outbreaks of violence, poses a big challenge to the government -- and an opportunity for far-left and far-right presidential candidates jockeying for power. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: India detains top 'cockroach' leader as hundreds protest in capital
item.description: Indian police detained Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leader Abhijeet Dipke on Friday ahead of fresh protests demanding the removal of the country's election chief, the youth-led movement said in a social media post. Dipke, 31, was detained shortly before a rally called by the online movement in the heart of New Delhi where hundreds of protesters marched on Friday evening, despite heavy security measures. FRANCE 24's Navodita Kumari reports from New Delhi, India. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.description: Ukrainian ​President Volodymyr Zelensky took aim on Friday at US President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's stance a "parody" of peace negotiations. At a European Union summit in Brussels, Zelenskiy said Russia did not want peace. He added that Ukraine was still experiencing disruptions to the SpaceX Starshield satellite system. item.title: France braces for massive protests: Yellow Vests to join students on Saturday
item.description: After weeks of student protests, France is set to be swept by broader, nationwide demonstrations on Saturday. The country's Yellow Vest movement – which eight years ago staged street protests against President Emmanuel Macron – has appealed to teachers, workers, pensioners and farmers, as well as students, in an online call spread through social media. The prospect of the two movements merging poses a big challenge to the government, as FRANCE 24’s Shirli Sitbon reports. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: REPLAY: Ukraine's Zelensky holds presser in Brussels
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Friday urged European leaders to maintain their support for Kyiv and warned against easing sanctions on Russia. Speaking to reporters at the European summit in Brussels, Zelensky said that ending the war remained Ukraine’s priority but accused Russian President Vladimir Putin of having no genuine interest in negotiations. He also criticised a US deal involving Russian diesel, arguing that easing restrictions could allow Moscow to reap financial benefits and pave the way for broader sanctions relief. Watch the replay. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: Zelensky asks EU for extra $79 billion to sustain Ukraine’s war effort
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Friday asked European Union leaders to provide Kyiv an extra 70 billion euros (US$79 billion) in funding next year to help it keep fighting Russia. “The war will cost 155 billion euros next year. And we need at least 70 billion euros more from you – for defence, for weapons and for our resilience,” Zelensky said in a speech at an EU summit in Brussels. “This is a realistic amount. And I ask you to find this support. It will help us hold Russia back.” The... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: US voters want action on global heating. So why are midterm candidates ‘climate hushing’?
item.description: Polls show that Democrats and Republicans in battleground states want to hear more from candidates about the climate crisis Most Americans feel unease or alarm about the climate crisis and, in both red and blue states, want to know how political leaders are going to fix it. But in midterm election campaigns across the US, candidates have responded to this desire with near silence. People in the US have this year endured a record hot summer as well as soaring costs, equating to roughly $2,000 per household , in extra energy and mortgage payments, due to the country’s dependence on a fossil… Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Campañas se enfocan en la seguridad y Hamás a semanas de las elecciones parlamentarias en Israel
item.description: A medida que se acercan las elecciones parlamentarias en Israel, las campañas de los candidatos se enfocan cada vez más en la seguridad y Hamás. Los aspirantes a ocupar el cargo de Benjamin Netanyahu han anunciado que, de ganar, harían cambios en las políticas actuales y las estrategias de lucha contra el grupo palestino.
